hero_heading: Paintings that feel like *a memory* you can hang on the wall.
hero_text: Original watercolors, hand-drawn charcoal portraits, and illustrations for children's books — plus online classes for anyone who wants to learn.
about_text:
I'm test name, a painter and illustrator working mostly in watercolor and charcoal. I love the way watercolor never quite does what you expect, and the way a charcoal portrait can catch the exact tilt of someone's smile.

When I'm not painting commissions or illustrating picture books, I teach online classes to students all over the world. I believe anyone can learn to make art they're proud of.
